entities.summary: Volodymyr Pavlovych Naumenko was a Ukrainian pedagogue, public figure and publicist. From 1893 to 1906, he was the chief editor of the monthly historical magazine Kievskaia starina. Naumenko served as deputy head of the Central Council of Ukraine, acting as its chairman until Mykhailo Hrushevsky returned from his exile, and was later appointed minister of education. He was executed by the Cheka for "counter-revolutionary activity".
